metadata.schedule_summary: Gemcitabine is given on Days 1, 8 and 15. Week 4 has no planned dose. Each cycle lasts 28 days. For lung cancer there is no fixed six-cycle limit in this source: continue only while the team considers treatment helpful and tolerable.

eligibility: Exact indication; ECOG0-2. Baseline ANC>1.5 and platelets>100; creatinine≤1.5ULN, transaminases≤3ULN.
Macroscopic complete resection belongs to the adjuvant pancreatic pathway; do not impose it on advanced NSCLC.
exclusions: Breastfeeding; pregnancy requires specialist risk assessment
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal and liver profile; audiometry and creatinine clearance if clinically indicated.
FBC before every dose; renal/liver profile before each cycle.
Response imaging, tumour markers where useful and post-treatment follow-up follow the consultant plan; no universal interval specified.
dose_modifications: Day1, within-cycle and baseline count thresholds differ. Prior severe marrow events use75% original cycle-initiation dose after review.
CrCl exactly30 is an unassigned source boundary. Bilirubin≥27:800mg/m², increase if tolerated.
Printed >3/>4 nonhaem rows conflict with usual Grade3/4 product guidance: hold severe toxicity and resolve with consultant; no inferred numeric reduction or permanent stop.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Single-agent gemcitabine low risk on each treatment day; no platinum prophylaxis.

treatment_phases.label: 00284a: adjuvant pancreas — six-cycle plan
treatment_phases.duration_text: Six 28-day cycles, or earlier disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m² IV on Days 1, 8 and 15. This finite plan applies to the pancreatic adjuvant indication only.

administration.notes: Infuse in 250 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 30 minutes on each treatment day. No dose on the other days. Starting dose may be reduced by the prescriber.

treatment_phases.label: 00284b: advanced NSCLC — no fixed cycle total
treatment_phases.duration_text: Repeat every 28 days until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; no source-fixed total number of cycles.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m² IV on Days 1, 8 and 15. Do not apply the pancreatic six-cycle limit to this lung indication.

administration.notes: Infuse in 250 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 30 minutes on each treatment day. No dose on the other days. Starting dose may be reduced by the prescriber.
